claims.claim: Can be used for storage of any kind of Liquid
claims.evidence: No interior or seal photos to confirm liquid-tightness or material compatibility.
No manufacturer stamp, resin code, or certification mark visible in either photo.

claims.claim: Used only once for clean water
claims.evidence: Interior of drums not shown; only exterior stacked view available.
Exterior shows scuffs and stains but no close-up or water-fill test to confirm structural integrity.
Bungholes visible facing outward in Photo 1 but lid/cap completeness and seal condition not clearly shown.

risks.risk: Interior residue, odor, or prior chemical contents despite 'clean water' claim
risks.proof: Video or photo looking into an open drum showing clean, dry, odor-free interior
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown/possibly contaminated, needing cleaning

risks.risk: Not actually food-grade plastic (no HDPE/resin code visible)
risks.proof: Close-up photo of embossed resin code or manufacturer food-grade stamp on drum base/side
risks.if_unproven: priced as industrial-grade only, not food-safe

risks.risk: Hidden cracks or leaks not visible in group photos
risks.proof: Close-up photos of each drum body and a water-fill/leak test clip
risks.if_unproven: priced as-is with possible leak risk, worst case

risks.risk: Mixed lot includes metal drums (seen on right edge) instead of only plastic
risks.proof: Confirmation photo/video clarifying exactly which drums (type/material) are included in this sale
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming only plastic drums counted, metal ones excluded

risks.risk: Unknown exact count and capacity of drums being sold
risks.proof: Photo/video with drums numbered or counted, plus capacity marking (e.g., 200L) visible
risks.if_unproven: priced per single standard-size drum, not as a bulk lot

risks.proof: Close-up of each lid showing intact seal, ring, and bung threads
risks.if_unproven: priced as lids possibly missing/damaged, needing replacement

proof_requests: Video of interior of at least 2-3 drums showing clean, dry, residue-free condition
Close-up photo of resin/food-grade stamp or manufacturer marking on drum base
Water-fill or tilt test clip showing no leaks at seams or bungholes
Clear count of drums included, with capacity markings visible
Close-up photos of lids/caps on each drum confirming completeness and seal
Clarification photo distinguishing plastic drums from the metal drums visible in Photo 1
response.reason: Witness confirms the item type as plastic storage drums, so a worst-case price is possible despite unverified food-grade, leak-free, and lid-complete claims from the seller.
